soundness_flags.label: sampling_model; ass:gaussian-blocks; thm:projection-envelope
soundness_flags.one_line: The model is called an independent two-sample experiment while allowing arbitrary within-pair covariance B_j; genuinely independent exposure and outcome GWAS summaries have B_j=0, so either impose B_j=0 or rename and define a correlated/overlapping-summary Gaussian experiment.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:whole-set-coverage
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact simultaneous containment is conditional on fixed p and finite K, mutually independent Gaussian blocks, and known positive-definite covariance blocks.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite-sample whole-set coverage only in the stated exact Gaussian subexperiment; it makes no exact GWAS, estimated-covariance, selection, or residual-LD claim.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:complete-inversion and oeq:certified-backend
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The arbitrary-real q branch requires exact-real sign oracles; unconditional termination is only claimed at q-plus on the complete algebraic input domain.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Completeness at q is oracle-relative, while unconditional bit-arithmetic certification is conditional on AlgInput and separately rebuilt q-plus certificates.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:regular-endpoint-limit
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Endpoint, component, pairing, and active-label recovery are conditioned on the explicit positive-width regular-face domain.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The stated joint endpoint limit holds only under nonzero first stages, unique stable active labels, separated components, and a positive exchange-cycle margin.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings paper exists as cited and describes tunable budget constraints, possibly disconnected feasible causal-effect sets, sharpness conditions, and asymptotically valid confidence sets.
The paper models two-sample summary associations separately, assumes exposure- and outcome-association estimates are independent, and proves asymptotic null results for mrAR, mrK, and mrCLR.

The preprint develops exact polynomial-root inversion for Anderson-Rubin and Lagrange-multiplier statistics and a geometric exact inversion method for CQLR; it does not state a quota-envelope optimizer-transition theorem.

VIPER proves strong validity for the true beta under a violation set containing the true alpha and derives a valid confidence set for that beta; its guarantee is pointwise in the structural parameter.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Resolve the sampling-model mismatch explicitly: use B_j=0 for genuinely independent two-sample GWAS, or formulate the main result for overlapping/correlated summary pairs and state how Omega_j is supplied.

Make the p=3, K=2 rational equality-tail and optimizer-switch certificate the first proved exhibit, including all six assignment inversions, before relying on the global exchange-cycle completeness claim.

After the exact backend is established, add a comparison theorem showing a concrete BudgetIV instance on which fixed-statistic root inversion cannot certify topology without the exchange-cycle partition.

recommended_next_step: Repair the two-sample versus arbitrary-B_j model specification, then advance the field-level quota-envelope and certified-inversion kernel to Stage 0.
